spec.description: VectorSearchCollectionSpec defines the desired state of VectorSearchCollection

dataSchema.description: Optional. JSON Schema for data. Field names must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.

description.description: Optional. User-specified description of the collection

displayName.description: Optional. User-specified display name of the collection

labels.description: Optional. Labels as key value pairs.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The VectorSearchCollection name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

vertexEmbeddingConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for generating embeddings for the vector field. If not specified, the embedding field must be populated in the DataObject.

modelID.description: Required. Required: ID of the embedding model to use. See https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/models#embeddings-models for the list of supported models.

taskType.description: Required. Required: Task type for the embeddings.

textTemplate.description: Required. Required: Text template for the input to the model. The template must contain one or more references to fields in the DataObject, e.g.: "Movie Title: {title} ---- Movie Plot: {plot}".

vectorSchema.description: Optional. Schema for vector fields. Only vector fields in this schema will be searchable. Field names must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.
